novelty_flags.label: Theorems 2–3 and Open-ended Question 1 literature map
novelty_flags.one_line: Add WangKolarDrton2023ConfidenceSets (and distinguish it from the present two-environment fiber): it constructs asymptotically valid causal-order confidence sets and model-uncertainty effect intervals, making it a closer omitted comparator than the generic constrained-M-estimation citation.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 1
soundness_flags.one_line: Relative interior of a semialgebraic branch does not imply its ambient tangent cone is R^d; require ambient interior/full local dimension, or retain T_b0(s0) in the product-score image.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The boundary random-set limit is conditional on tangent-cone regularity and C1 branch extensions at the specified boundary point.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The stated Fell/Hausdorff limits hold only under ass:tangent-cone-regularity and ass:branch-smoothness.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The minimax problem is posed only after conditioning on a singleton zeroth-order target and a fixed bounded tangent radius R.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Any attainment or pullback conclusion is conditional on Gamma(s0)={tau0} and the bounded branch-labelled Gaussian experiment Lambda_R.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: LDiffPC with perfect conditional-equality information recovers the true difference-graph skeleton and adds only correct orientations under its diff-faithfulness assumption.
Theorem 2 gives an asymptotic confidence set for one total causal effect and an explicit closed-form union of intervals under linear equal-error-variance DAG structure.

For Gaussian FCI the paper states exact finite-sample coverage with known variance for a selected adjustment functional under its Markov-blanket condition, with different approximate guarantees for the structural effect.
The paper establishes conditions for identifying total and direct causal changes and effects from a given difference graph, rather than post-discovery sampling inference.
DCI studies two linear-Gaussian DAGs with a shared topological order and estimates a difference-graph skeleton from regression-coefficient invariances before partial orientation.
The paper constructs asymptotically valid confidence sets for causal orderings and explains their post-processing into causal-effect intervals that incorporate model uncertainty.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair Proposition 1 by requiring s0 to be an ambient interior point of its branch cell (or explicitly retain the tangent-cone intersection); then state the product-score formula only under that corrected condition.

Add Wang, Kolar, and Drton's causal-order confidence-set construction, plus the earlier Strieder et al. confidence-set line, and state precisely why their asymptotic order/model unions cannot deliver the paired LDiffPC fiber or its boundary law.

Promote the lower-bound contribution from a two-model witness to a nondegenerate local class of observationally equivalent paired SCMs, and relate its diameter bound to the proposed union's local width.

Give an executable finite-p branch-enumeration/pruning algorithm with termination and complexity bounds, or identify a practically useful fixed-structure subclass; this would turn the semialgebraic representation into a stronger constructive contribution.
